annotations.title: Domain DNS, email security and registration lookup

description: Look up a domain in one call: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, SOA), email security (SPF, DMARC and its policy) and registration from RDAP (registrar, created, expiry date, days to expiry, status). Plain-English notes flag missing SPF/DMARC or a domain about to expire. Use for domain due diligence, email deliverability checks, phishing triage or checking a site's setup. Send domain (example.com) or a URL. Errors: 400 invalid domain. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL also works)
